Name: Bethesda Plugin Manager
Author: Hierocles (Originally by Parapets)
Description: Manages plugin load order for Bethesda Game Studios game engines

ReleaseNotes: Not backward compatible with MO2 2.5.2 and earlier.

Brought the plugin panel up to parity with upstream MO2's plugin list panel: Form Version/Header Version/Author/Description columns and tooltip lines, highlighting the masters of a selected plugin, and gating LOOT's sorted load order behind an explicit Apply in the LOOT dialog.
